build_hashing_memory: build a hashing memory module with flat, pq_default, or pq_fast implementation using HashingMemory.build
register_memory_args: register memory parameters on an argparse parser via HashingMemory.register_args
check_memory_params: check and initialize memory parameters with HashingMemory.check_params
read_hashing_memory: read from a hashing memory by passing input tensors to HashingMemory.forward
initialize_memory_keys: initialize memory keys with binary, gaussian, or uniform types in HashingMemoryFlat.init_keys
